description: The bar chart, titled “NDCG@10,” presents the results of an ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset, comparing the performance of four variants of a conversation recommendation system based on a generative reward model and simulated user: “Ours,” “- critiquing,” “- scoring,” and “- ranking.” The vertical axis represents NDCG@10 scores, ranging from 0.05 to 0.25 with tick marks at intervals of 0.05, while the horizontal axis lists the four system configurations. The “Ours” variant, shown in orange, achieves the highest score at approximately 0.21. The “- critiquing” variant, in blue, follows closely with a score of about 0.19. The “- scoring” variant, also in blue, shows a significant drop to approximately 0.07, indicating that generative item scoring contributes substantially to performance. The “- ranking” variant, in blue as well, scores around 0.12, suggesting that efficient candidate ranking also plays an important role. The bars are not sorted by value but are ordered according to the caption’s description, with “Ours” first and the ablated components following. The chart visually emphasizes the relative importance of each component by showing the performance degradation when each is removed, with “scoring” having the most pronounced impact.
